Package nl.pim16aap2.animatedarchitecture.core.api

@NullMarked package nl.pim16aap2.animatedarchitecture.core.api
This package contains various APIs used throughout the project, including definitions for animated blocks, colors, debugging, factories, highlighted block spawners, the platform interface, and more.

Most of the implementations for the interfaces are provided by the modules for specific platforms (e.g. Spigot).
